description: Loads a public web page in a real Chromium browser, with JavaScript run, from a residential IP in the country you choose, and returns the visible text, title, final URL and HTTP status, optionally the rendered HTML and a screenshot, plus proof of where the request came from (exit IP, country, city, timezone). Useful to see prices, content or availability as a visitor in that country sees them. Respects robots.txt; no clicks, logins or CAPTCHA solving. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the page must be loaded from, e.g. IT, DE, US; GET /render/countries lists the ones served now

device.description: viewport and user agent class (default desktop)

fullPage.description: screenshot the full page instead of the viewport

html.description: return the rendered HTML (up to 1 MB)

screenshot.description: return a JPEG screenshot (images are not loaded, layout is)

waitMs.description: extra wait after load, in ms (default 0)

waitUntil.description: when the page counts as loaded (default load)

name: render_page
title: Geo render from a residential IP
